answer: Split each epoch's beacon through a prism: every identity gets a challenge salted with its own key, so work cannot be shared between identities. Answering it means growing a crystal — a strictly sequential memory-hard proof no machine can parallelize, so one machine serves only one identity per window; each live identity needs its own lane. A miss ripples through the streak ledger, and rewards scale with consecutive live windows. Ten thousand sockpuppets need ten thousand live lanes — the farm's hardware bill outruns its yield, so the attack is self-defeating.
